title: Mail
description: The address that sends every platform email: invitations, sign-in links, password resets, email changes, notifications and reports.
devNotice: Development mode: every email goes to Mailpit (<link>open Mailpit</link>), not to real inboxes. Set EMAIL_DEV_REAL_SEND=1 to send through the sender below.

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.hint: Your Gmail address with a Google App Password. About 500 emails a day.

google_workspace.name: Google Workspace
google_workspace.hint: A Workspace mailbox with an App Password. About 2,000 emails a day.

microsoft365.name: Microsoft 365 / Outlook
microsoft365.hint: smtp.office365.com. Your tenant admin may have to allow SMTP AUTH for the mailbox.

zoho.name: Zoho Mail
zoho.hint: smtp.zoho.com (use smtp.zoho.sa or .eu if your account is hosted there).

resend.name: Resend (API key)
resend.hint: Recommended for production with your own domain (SPF / DKIM verified in Resend).

smtp.name: Custom SMTP
smtp.hint: Any SMTP server: host, port and security from your provider.

gmailSteps.title: Connect Gmail in three steps
gmailSteps.step1: Turn on 2-Step Verification for the Google account.
gmailSteps.step2: Create an App Password (name it “Central”) and copy the 16 characters.
gmailSteps.step3: Paste it below as the password, with your full Gmail address as the username and the From email.
gmailSteps.limit: Gmail allows roughly 500 messages a day from a personal account; for more, use Google Workspace or Resend with your own domain.

outlookNote: If the test says the login was rejected, ask your Microsoft 365 admin to enable “Authenticated SMTP” for this mailbox.

fields.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved one ({hint})
fields.dailyLimitHint: Emails a day through this sender; past it, mail goes through the backup sender or waits until tomorrow.

fromMismatch: {provider} sends only as the signed-in account ({username}) or a verified alias. Use the same address, or add {from} as an alias in the provider first — otherwise it will be rewritten or rejected.
removeBody: Emails go back to the default (environment) sender. The stored password is deleted.
testQueued: Test email queued; it will be retried.

status.title: Status
status.fallbackAlert: The configured sender has been failing since {when}; emails are going out through the backup sender.

errors.auth_failed: Wrong username or password. For Gmail, use an App Password, not your normal password.
errors.port_blocked: Couldn't reach the server on that port (blocked by a firewall or wrong port).
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
errors.tls_failed: The secure connection (TLS) failed. Check the security setting matches the port (587 = STARTTLS, 465 = SSL).
errors.host_not_found: The SMTP host doesn't exist. Check the spelling.
errors.sender_rejected: The provider rejected the From address. Use the signed-in account or a verified alias / domain.
errors.api_key_invalid: The API key is invalid or doesn't have sending access.
errors.rate_limited: The provider is limiting sends right now.
errors.daily_limit: Today's sending limit was reached; it will go out tomorrow.

log.title: Email log
log.description: Every email from the last 90 days. Sign-in and invitation links aren't kept.
log.subject: Subject
log.emptyBody: Emails appear here as soon as the platform sends them.
